about: One entry per merged process-fix PR that names the error rows it fixes (#2058). Add your PR's entry in the same PR. stage: the step the PR fixed, each re-run its own way (error-fix-targets.ts): read (Rosetta's read step reopens each named document and reads it again under the fixed reader), extract (Knox reads stored texts again once its rules version moves), verify (Darwin's verified recheck reads each named live fee again after the merge day) or publish (a direct run's publish step for each named institution runs Hamilton's publish and sweeps again). A wrong document re-runs through Magellan's link search (#2055) and is not an entry. merged_on: the day the PR merges (ISO date); only errors recorded before that day (UTC) are named, and every re-run but extract's must come on or after it. The fix must change what its step does to the named fees: a named fee still live is judged as it stands, so a PR that only changes a check would close rows without a re-run that changed anything. knox_version: extract fixes only, the KNOX_RULES_STRATEGY.version the PR bumps to (never above the shipped version); leave it out for read, verify and publish. Name the rows by pipeline_feedback check_name (checks), kind (kinds) or id (feedback_ids); at least one. A read entry names only rows that name a document. Only rows raised by a check the daily re-check can judge are named: those the fresh audit re-runs (ERROR_FIX_CHECKS: hamilton.source_check, hamilton.category_guard, deming.not_a_fee_line, deming.name_quality) and, for a verify fix, darwin.verified_recheck, whose verdict Darwin's recheck records again. After merge, the fixed step re-runs for each named row (Atlas's direct path asks for its institution for read, extract and publish fixes, and for a verify fix whose named fee is down), and Deming's daily error-fix re-check closes the rows whose fee, or the fee the re-run produced in its place, now matches the bank's own document under the fresh audit and checkFeeAgainstSource on its own document, and reports the rest.
